scope: retrospective position-only delivery replay on three August 29 UGV01 AprilTag-referenced runs
provenance_note: The tolerances are informed by the previously completed UGV01 physical-fidelity characterization. This is not a prospectively blinded protocol, but its definitions are frozen before computing the ledger outcomes.

reference.gap_rule: A service sample or relative-motion pair is excluded when its required reference interval crosses an adjacent aligned-reference gap greater than 0.75 s.
reference.denominator: Only temporally observable samples or complete relative-motion pairs surviving the reference-gap rule.

services.rationale: 10 cm short-horizon tracking requirement for low-speed indoor motion.
25 cm medium-horizon tolerance, approximately one rover-body-scale displacement.
50 cm preview tolerance for accumulated low-speed relative-motion error.
50 cm global synchronization tolerance within the 2.0 m by 1.5 m reference area.

ledger_categories.already_qualified: qualified under both primary degraded and primary ideal delivery
ledger_categories.delivery_remediable: not qualified under degraded delivery but qualified under ideal delivery
ledger_categories.persistent: not qualified even under ideal delivery
ledger_categories.degradation_induced: qualified under degraded delivery but not under ideal delivery; treated as an implementation/audit warning

claim_boundary: This analysis tests whether the remediability taxonomy computes on a second physical platform. Three runs do not support population-level rates, cross-surface claims, or online resource-savings claims.
